description: Shifts the pitch of two signals without changing their speed, working on the spectrum through an FFT

params.text: Sets what the pitch is multiplied by, 0 to 4; 1 leaves the pitch alone, 2 puts it an octave up, 0.5 an octave down, and at 0 the signal passes through untouched

inputs.text: The left signal to be shifted
The right signal to be shifted; with nothing patched here the left signal is used for both

outputs.text: The left signal at the shifted pitch
The right signal at the shifted pitch

notes: nothing is computed and neither output is written until a cable is patched into InL
the shift works on blocks of 4096 samples, so the output is behind the input by that much and a sharp attack is smeared across the block

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the InL jack.
